title: MABEL: Attenuating Gender Bias using Textual Entailment Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using intrinsic metrics (StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs focusing on the gender domain to measure stereotypical associations) and extrinsic downstream tasks including occupation classification (Bias-in-Bios), coreference resolution (WinoBias), and natural language inference (Bias-NLI) to measure performance disparities across genders. Also evaluated using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to measure the cosine similarity between representations of target concepts and gender-associated attribute words.
